There are multiple enactments of 321.320

  *321.320.  Property in city of 40,000 inhabitants not wholly within district, to be excluded — requirements for certain annexed areas (Boone, Jackson, Jefferson, St. Charles, St. Louis counties) — exceptions (Crystal City, Festus, Herculaneum). —

*Revisor's Note: This section was declared unconstitutional in City of De Soto v. Parson, see 2021 annotation below.
